text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond runs in the Satsuki Sho. However, another Umamusume's stumble leaves her finishing in third place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Satono family jinx of never winning G1 races still hangs over her, but instead of feeling sorry for herself, Satono Diamond feels invigorated and swears to win the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though Kitasan Black and Satono Diamond run in different races, they continue to encourage each other on their parallel paths.
